regions.purpose: Identifies the Collection — title leads with a colored dot rendering the Collection's appearance — and holds the Collection-level affordances.
Collapsed-by-default section that expands in place to show the Collection's metadata.
The Collection's Entries, browsable as a sortable vertical list.

affordances.label: Expand or collapse the Details section
Open the sort menu and pick the active sort key
affordances.notes: A single sort chip above the list reads `Sort: {active key} {direction-arrow}`. Tap opens a menu whose options are derived from Collection state: `Date Added` and `Review Time` are always present; `Score` appears iff the Collection's Review template defines a rating field; `Power Rank` appears iff `Collection.powerRanking` is on ([[03-concepts]], doc01.03 §1). `Near Me` is named but inert until device location lands.

affordances.label: Toggle the active sort's direction (ascending or descending)
affordances.notes: Direction arrow on the sort chip; tapping it flips ascending/descending. Suppressed when the active sort is `Power Rank` — the user's authored order has no asc/desc axis.

affordances.label: Drag an entry to a new position in the Power Rank order
affordances.notes: Available only when the active sort is `Power Rank`. The list renders leading drag handles; releasing an item writes back the entry's rank position. Switching to any other sort key removes the handles and the list becomes read-only ordering.

affordances.label: Export the Collection — KML or GeoJSON
View on map
affordances.notes: Re-enters MapOverview with `filter-context` set to a single-element set containing this Collection's id; the viewport fits to the Collection's Entries (MapOverview.jumpToCollection). Single-Collection variant of CollectionList's APPLY_FILTER.

shows: a short summary of the Entry's Review
the Review's score, when the Collection's template defines a rating field

lists.emptyState: When the Collection has no Entries, the region shows a hint pointing at Add a Collection Entry.
